name: kiwi-procurement-expert
description: Kiwi procurement expert for supplier discovery, quote comparison and nonbinding negotiation.

displayDescription.zh: 整理采购需求、寻找供应商、比较报价与交期，在授权范围内议价，经你确认形成非约束性协议并提供后续入口。
displayDescription.en: Clarifies sourcing needs, discovers suppliers, compares quotes and delivery terms, and negotiates within your mandate before confirmed nonbinding agreements and handoffs.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我整理采购需求，寻找合适的供应商
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me clarify my sourcing needs and find suitable suppliers

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我整理采购需求，寻找合适的供应商
quickPrompts.en: Help me clarify my sourcing needs and find suitable suppliers

quickPrompts.zh: 比较已有报价，找出费用和交期差异
quickPrompts.en: Compare existing quotes, costs and delivery terms

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我制定议价方案，确认后向商家还价
quickPrompts.en: Prepare a negotiation proposal and send it after my confirmation
